name: Affiliate AI Lite
author: Rustaurius

sections.description:
Easily add Amazon affiliate product boxes to your website with the Affiliate AI Lite plugin from AFFI. The #1 AI affiliate plugin now has a lite version that you can get right here and start making money from your Amazon affiliate links directly on your website for free!

The plugin makes full use of Amazon’s new Creators API, so you can ensure maximum results with no downtime.

Set up is very quick. Just input your Amazon affiliate info and then add your links and product boxes to any page or post using our handy shortcode, block or via Elementor.

Check out the Amazon affiliate demo!

Key Features

  • Add an unlimited number of Amazon affiliate product boxes to your site.
  • These are visual product boxes, and not just links, so your customers can see the actual products, like they are browsing Amazon.
  • Creators API implementation for full up-to-date compatibility.
  • Add your Amazon associate info and earn commission via the links in your product boxes.
  • Products can be added via block or shortcode.
  • Also works with third-party editors like Elementor.
  • Choose your caching time, to speed up page and product loading.
  • Option to include product structured data.
  • Built-in local product health diagnostics to help troubleshoot product issues.
  • Generate a redacted diagnostic download when troubleshooting with support.
  • Zero coding!

Get Set Up in No Time!

In our easy-to-use affiliate settings panel, you can add your Amazon tracking ID and API information. Then all you need to do is add our product boxes to any page or post on your site using our included block or shortcode or via Elementor!

Creators API

The plugin now makes use of the Amazon Creators API (instead of the now-deprecated PA API), so you can make sure that your product boxes will continue to show and drive sales uninterrupted. Just paste your credentials in the plugin settings and it will work/sync automatically!

Earn Amazon Affiliate Commission from Your WordPress Site

The plugin uses the Amazon tracking ID you provide to automatically generate affiliate links for all products that display. Earning commission from Amazon affiliate sales has never been easier.

Add Affiliate Products to New and Existing Content

One of the greatest benefits of using this plugin for Amazon associates is that you can now earn commission for the content you already have on your site. You can add affiliate product boxes to any part of any existing post or page simply by inserting the shortcode or block. And with the ability to specify which exact Amazon products you want to showcase, you can serve the most appropriate content to your audience while increasing your commissions sales and conversion rate.

And, of course, any time you add a new post/review/etc. to your site, you can now include corresponding Amazon affiliate products in a matter of seconds. Never create a page or post without them again!

🌟 Maximize your affiliate earning potential with the pro version of AFFI AI, which includes many more built-in merchants (e.g. eBay, AliExpress), custom merchants, Amazon no API mode, AI auto blogging, SMS price drop alerts for your audience, and so much more!

Increase Conversions by Customizing Your Product Boxes

Take your affiliate product boxes one step further with the customization options built in to our plugin. With options to either pull the product descriptions straight from Amazon or to manually type them in, you can choose the right copy to engage with your audience.

Additionally, you can change the call to action type, if you believe that your audience would be better engaged either with just a button or also with the merchant name and logo.

You can also set the product caching time and even manually clear the cache for a specific product box, keeping you in full control over which content you want displayed.

Enhanced Product Info

In addition to these customization options, you can also set your own ratings for products and even list pros and cons. This allows you to make sure you are matching the content of your page/post and to entice your audience and make the products you are listing extra attractive to them.

Troubleshoot Product Issues More Easily

Affiliate AI Lite includes local product health diagnostics to help you troubleshoot problems with your Amazon product boxes.

If you need additional help, you can also generate a redacted diagnostic download containing useful troubleshooting information that can be shared with support.

Amazon No API Mode (Requires Pro Version)

Start displaying products and earning affiliate commissions from day one!

Amazon has recently drastically increased the criteria that needs to be met for you to qualify to get access to the API and display affiliate products on your site.

With that in mind, we’ve developed a no API mode that lets you display products and earn commission from Amazon sales with only a tracking ID. This is the perfect way to start earning immediately while you wait to hit the minimums required for access to their API.

Use AI to Generate Product Boxes (Requires Pro Version)

The pro version of the plugin takes all the work out of your hands when it comes to displaying product boxes. Using AFFI’s own built-in AI algorithm, the plugin can automatically populate all of your posts with Amazon affiliate product boxes that match the content of the post. You read that right. You do not need to manually add any shortcodes or blocks to any posts or pages. And you do not need to set any specific products. Using our affiliate AI algorithm, the plugin will automatically fetch and display products that match the content.

You just set how many products to show and where, and presto!

Automatically Monetize Existing Content!

One of the best things about using AI to generate product boxes is that this also applies to all the existing content on your site. Have 500 old blog posts? Revitalize them and put them to work for you. Using AI, AFFI can read the content of each of your posts and automatically insert relevant affiliate product boxes. No need to manually edit each post or do anything at all. It’s all automatic and applies to all posts on your site, including those that were there before you installed AFFI. So start making money off your old posts!

Learn More

ChatGPT Integration

As an extra option in the pro version, you can change the algorithm to use ChatGPT instead of the built-in AFFI algorithm. This requires that you enter your OpenAI credentials, but gives you an alternative that, depending on the type of content you have on your site or the products you would like to link to, can display different and/or more appropriate results.

Show Products from Merchants other than Amazon (Requires Pro Version)

The pro version also allows you to show product boxes and have affiliate links to products available from merchants other than Amazon. With built-in integration for eBay,Ali Express and Kelkoo in our AFFI AI version and, additionally, the entire AWIN, Effiliation and Tradedoubler platforms in our AFFIMAX version, these merchants will work out of the box just like Amazon.

Add Your Own Custom Merchants

On top of this, the pro version also lets you add your own completely custom merchants. For example, if you are part of the affiliate program for a specific merchant that falls outside of one of the above platforms, you can add your affiliate/partner data for this merchant and generate your own custom link that can be used in the plugin to display a product box from this merchant!

You can even combine built-in merchants and custom merchants to create advanced product boxes that list prices from all sources.

Sync WooCommerce Prices (Requires Pro Version)

The pro version comes with an option that lets you pull the prices for your WooCommerce products directly from your affiliate merchants. You set the shortcode to use for this, meaning you are in full control of the price displayed and where it’s pulled from. You can set a single merchant (such as just Amazon) or you can set it to pull from several different merchants and use the lowest price available as the price of the WooCommerce product.

Take all the guess work out of the shopping experience for your audience and customers!

AI Auto Blogging (Requires Pro Version)

AFFI AI pro comes with the ability to automatically generate new posts using AI, with content and AFFI product boxes that match keywords and prompts of your choosing. This feature uses OpenAI/ChatGPT and opens a whole new world of letting your site and affiliate earnings manage itself.

Learn More

SMS Price Drop Alerts (Requires Pro Version)

The pro AFFI AI version comes with a feature that lets visitors sign up for price drop alerts for specific products. When you enable this feature, it adds a “Price Alert” button to each product displayed by the plugin. Clicking this button opens a form, in which the visitor can enter their phone number and click the “Sign Up” button. After doing this, if the price of the item drops, the person will receive an SMS notifying them of the drop and the new price.

Learn More

Need More? We’ve Got You Covered with the Pro Version!

Enhance your experience by customizing the Affiliate AI plugin to your exact needs with the following pro features:

  • 100% automated AI affiliate product boxes
  • Keyword-generated product boxes
  • Built-in integration for eBay, Ali Express and Kelkoo, as well as the AWIN, Effiliation and Tradedoubler platforms.
  • Add any custom merchant
  • Choose from several different product box designs
  • Full array of styling options for the product boxes
  • Add your own custom CSS
  • Pull prices directly from affiliate merchants for your WooCommerce products
  • Set icons and text for product rankings
  • And more!

Used Libraries

  • Simple jQuery Popup – https://github.com/kirilkirkov/Simple-jQuery-Popup
  • FontIconPicker – https://github.com/farbelous/fontIconPicker

For further information and purchasing options, please visit our WordPress Affiliate AI plugin homepage for the AFFI AI version or the AFFIMAX homepage.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ‘affiliate-ai-lite’ folder to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress

or

  1. Go to the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress and click ‘Add New’
  2. Search for ‘Affiliate AI Lite’ and select ‘Install Now’
  3. Activate the plugin when prompted
sections.faq:
What can I do if an Amazon product box is not working as expected?

Affiliate AI Lite includes local product health diagnostics to help with troubleshooting. You can also generate a redacted diagnostic download to provide additional information when contacting support.

For more info, help and support

For more info, documentation, help and support, please see our websites here:

https://www.affimax.com

https://affi.ai/
sections.changelog:
1.1.0 (2026-10-05)

  • Restored the Amazon product block in the WordPress editor while preserving existing block attributes.
  • Added local product health diagnostics to make product issues easier to troubleshoot.
  • Added a redacted diagnostic download for sharing troubleshooting information with support.
  • Corrected settings reads to improve consistency when loading saved plugin configuration.
  • Added safeguards to prevent Affiliate AI Lite from being active at the same time as a paid AFFI edition.

1.0.6 (2026-05-15)

  • Fixes for a few PHP warnings and deprecated notices.
  • Compatible with WordPress 7.0.

1.0.5 (2026-04-30)

  • Implemented Creators API.

1.0.4 (2026-02-20)

  • Updates to correct/remove the load textdomain notices.

1.0.3 (2026-01-27)

  • Plugin now makes use of Amazon’s OffersV2 resource.

1.0.2 (2025-11-19)

  • Update with patch for reported Wordfence vulnerability.

1.0.1 (2025-07-21)

  • Fix for a few errors related to classnames.

1.0.0 (2025-07-18)

  • Initial version.
